Write three things you are grateful for each day and build a gratitude streak.

📖 How to use

  1. Type three things you are grateful for today.
  2. Click Save Today's Gratitudes.
  3. Come back tomorrow — each consecutive day grows your streak.
  4. Scroll the history to revisit past entries.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the streak work?

Save one set of three gratitudes per day. Each day you complete keeps the streak alive; missing a day resets it to zero.

Can I see past gratitudes?

Yes — every day you save is stored as a dated record, and the full history is listed below.

Are my gratitudes private?

Only in this browser. Nothing is uploaded, so you must keep using the same browser/device.

Do they have to be big things?

Yes — any three things, big or small. The habit matters more than the size of the items.
